candidates.location_hint: The outer container wrapping all accordion items
candidates.why: It lacks a grouping role to establish the relationship between triggers and panels, which might confuse screen readers about the widget's structure.

candidates.location_hint: The conditional content panels that appear when expanded
candidates.why: They are rendered as plain divs without a region role or a label pointing back to their trigger button, so assistive technology may not announce them as distinct interactive regions.

candidates.location_hint: The trigger buttons and their referenced content panels
candidates.why: The reference attribute pointing to the content area targets elements that are conditionally removed from the DOM when collapsed, which can break tracking for some assistive technologies.
There is no visible or documented support for arrow key navigation between triggers, which is standard for this widget type and expected by power users.

candidates.location_hint: The focus behavior when a panel expands or collapses
candidates.why: Focus remains on the trigger button after toggling, which might leave users unsure whether the content is active or if they need to tab into it manually.
